data.name: Private Dolphin Playground Safari
data.headline: Wild Atlantic dolphins on their own time
data.description:
A three-hour private charter to the shallow backcountry channels where Atlantic bottlenose dolphins live and play year-round. Your USCG-licensed captain knows the local pods by behavior pattern, cuts the engines in the right spots, and you drift in quiet water — often within a few yards of the boat. This is not a captive-encounter tour. No feeding, no enclosures, no performance. We follow strict National Marine Fisheries Service distance guidelines for sustainable encounters.

Quick facts: 

• 3 hrs $995 
• Private 
• USCG-licensed captain 
• Perry Hotel & Marina 
• Fuel + safety gear included

data.itinerary:
Departure – Perry Hotel & Marina
Meet at Dock A, Slip #32. After a brief safety overview, we cruise into the calm Gulf and backcountry waters where wild dolphins are most commonly found.

Dolphin Search & Observation
Your captain navigates through known feeding and travel areas where Atlantic bottlenose dolphins frequently surface. We maintain respectful viewing distances while allowing natural curiosity to bring dolphins closer if they choose.

Pods may surface, travel, play, or occasionally surf the wake — every encounter is unique.

Wildlife & Scenic Cruising
Along the way, you may also see sea turtles, rays, pelicans, osprey, and other marine and bird life that thrive in these protected waters.

Optional Scenic Stop (Conditions Permitting)
Time and conditions permitting, enjoy a brief scenic drift in a calm area to relax and take in the surroundings.

Return Cruise
Enjoy a smooth ride back with unforgettable memories of your wild encounter.

Dear Guests,

We’re excited to welcome you aboard your Private Dolphin Safari — a 3-hour wildlife experience in the calm waters surrounding Key West.

Please review the important details below to ensure a smooth and memorable encounter.

✅ Before Your Charter

For trips up to six passengers:

AND for trips with 7th and 8th passengers:

All required forms must be completed prior to arrival.

🐬 Your Dolphin Experience

This private safari explores known dolphin habitats in the Gulf and backcountry waters.

While dolphin sightings are common, they are wild animals and cannot be guaranteed. Every encounter is unique and conducted with respectful wildlife viewing practices.

You may also see sea turtles, rays, and migratory birds.

📍 Departure Details

Dock A, Slip #32
7001 Shrimp Rd
Stock Island, FL 33040

Please arrive 15 minutes prior to departure.

🩺 Health & Safety

This is generally a calm-water cruise.

Guests should be comfortable boarding and riding on a vessel.

The captain may adjust route based on weather or wildlife movement.

🎁 Complimentary Access

As my charter guests, you may enjoy access to The Perry Hotel & Marina pools and fitness center before and after your charter.

We look forward to sharing a truly special wildlife experience with you.

Best regards,
David McFadden
Owner, Six Fins Charter
